materialImprovements: Password reset fails closed when privileged reviewer sessions cannot be invalidated.
Owner email-proof recovery uses the same fail-closed privileged-session invalidation rule.
Verified email is required at reviewer sign-in and rechecked on every privileged reviewer request.
Removing email verification revokes an already-issued reviewer session.
The existing one-time reviewer email-confirmation helper is wired into reviewer sign-in.
Reviewer console v2 acceptance contracts are aligned with the actual current runtime while preserving migration-integrity failure testing.
Regression coverage proves session-invalidation ordering and failure semantics for both recovery routes.

blocker.detail: The permanent Local Community Platform build command permits deployment only when separately authorized. The Franklin runtime and static Render services both have auto-deploy disabled. Official main exact-head qualification requires the live runtime /health release to equal the candidate release, so the gate cannot honestly pass before an authorized R1356 runtime deployment.
